properties.name: netcdf_metadata
properties.cwl:
cwlVersion: v1.2
$namespaces:
  s: https://schema.org/
  edam: http://edamontology.org/
$graph:
- class: CommandLineTool
  id: netcdf_metadata_medslik
  baseCommand: python
  arguments:
  - /opt/parse.py
  - --netcdf_file
  - valueFrom: "${\n  // Find the first .nc file in the input directory (recursively\
      \ if needed)\n  function findNetcdfFile(dir) {\n    console.log(\"Searching\
      \ for NetCDF file in:\", dir);\n    if (dir.class === 'File' && dir.basename.endsWith('.nc'))\
      \ return dir.path;\n    if (dir.class === 'Directory' && dir.listing) {\n  \
      \    for (const f of dir.listing) {\n        const found = findNetcdfFile(f);\n\
      \        if (found) return found;\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n \
      \ const ncPath = findNetcdfFile(inputs.medslik_result);\n  if (!ncPath) throw\
      \ new Error('No NetCDF file found in directory');\n  return ncPath;\n}\n"
  - --extra_props
  - valueFrom: $(runtime.outdir + '/extra_props.json')
  inputs:
    medslik_result:
      type: Directory
      loadListing: deep_listing
  outputs:
    metadata:
      outputBinding:
        glob: ./metadata.json
      type: File
  requirements:
    MultipleInputFeatureRequirement: {}
    ResourceRequirement: {}
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: iliad-repository.inesctec.pt/netcdf-metadata:0.1.0
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing: "${\n  return [{\n    \"class\": \"File\",\n    \"basename\": \"extra_props.json\"\
        ,\n    \"contents\": JSON.stringify({\n      \"description\": \"Medslik simulation\
        \ NetCDF file\",\n      \"keywords\": [\"metadata\", \"medslik\", \"netcdf\"\
        ],\n    })}];\n}\n"
  s:name: netcdf_metadata
  s:softwareVersion: 0.1.0
  s:description: Extract metadata from NetCDF file
  s:keywords:
  - netcdf
  - metadata
  s:programmingLanguage: python
  s:producer:
    class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:sourceOrganization:
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:author:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Miguel Correia
    s:email: miguel.r.correia@inesctec.pt
  s:dateCreated: '2025-11-13T17:39:29Z'
  s:identifier: urn:apkg:tool:inesctec:pt:netcdf_metadata_medslik:0.1.0
  s:sdDatePublished: '2025-11-13T17:41:34.435696Z'
  s:sdPublisher:
    class: Organization
    name: Application Package Registry
    url: https://iliad-registry.inesctec.pt
